title: Establishment of Central Consumer Protection Council

content.scenario: The Central Government wants to set up a council to advise on consumer protection matters. The council needs to be established by notification.
content.outcome: The Central Government shall establish the Central Consumer Protection Council by notification, with effect from a specified date, to be known as the Central Council. This Council will advise on consumer protection matters and provide a platform for discussion and deliberation.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Consumer Protection Council?
How will the Central Government establish the Central Consumer Protection Council?
What are the functions of the Central Consumer Protection Council?
